name: lingdt-decision-1.1-27b
description:
LingDT-Decision (27B) is an in-house System One model from Ant Digital Technologies, designed for decision-making tasks across software development workflows. It addresses the fundamental mismatch between traditional large language models (LLMs) and decision workloads in terms of efficiency, reliability, and cost.
In addition to three common decision modes—choice (single-select), bool (binary judgment), and score (scoring)—LingDT-Decision natively supports multi-choice (multi-select). Its confidence scores are carefully calibrated for more reliable and trustworthy outputs. During the free-access period, the model supports up to 16K context per request, up to 32 questions per request, a DAG depth of 3, and a maximum of 255 options.API Guide：maas.antdigital.com/docs/lingdt-decision-api-guide
zhDescription: 蚂蚁数科自研System One 模型LingDT-Decision（27B版本），主要用于各种软件研发过程的决策类型任务。基于mid-train技术，模型能更好的对各场景或领域进行适配，从而解决传统大语言模型（LLM）在效率、可靠性和成本上存在的根本性错配问题。除了支持choice（单选）、noul（判断）、score（打分）三种常见决策模式，LingDT-Decision还原生支持multi-choice (多选)。此外，基于强化学习技术，模型在返回的置信度方面实现深度对齐，使得模型更加可靠、可信。模型支持单请求最大64K上下文，单问题最大32K上下文，单次请求最多32个问题，DAG深度为5， 最大支持255个选项。接入指南：maas.antdigital.com/docs/lingdt-decision-api-guide
